columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the message which is being sent out to through different media.

columns.name: RESPONSE_REQUIRED
columns.description: This field indicates whether response is required for the specific message delivery or not.

columns.name: RESPONSE_STATUS
columns.description: The response status which is sent as part of user response. Will have values like ACKNOWLEDGED APPROVED REJECT

columns.name: COMMUNICATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the communication table row related to which this individual message is.

columns.name: DELIVERY_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the message delivery. This field indicates whether a message is sucessfully delivered or not.

columns.name: COMMUNICATION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of the communication through which the message is being sent.

columns.name: COMMUNICATION_ADDRESS
columns.description: Communication Address phone number, device id etc

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: GUID of the user to whom the message is intented to.

columns.name: DELIVERY_TRACKER_ID
columns.description: The tracker identification key which is obtained while sending the email.

columns.name: DELIVERY_TYPE
columns.description: The field indicates the type of the message delivery.

columns.name: RULE_NODE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the rule node for which message is sent.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_TYPE
columns.description: The field indicates whether the recipient is of cc or bcc or to type.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: The field indicate the identifier used of grouping the data.
